name: WormBase_get_gene
description: Get detailed gene overview from WormBase for C. elegans (nematode worm) by WormBase gene ID. Returns gene name, sequence name, species, description, gene type, and status. C. elegans is one of the most important model organisms for genetics, neuroscience, and developmental biology. Example: WBGene00006763 returns unc-26 (synaptojanin, a polyphosphoinositide phosphatase required for synaptic vesicle recycling). NOTE: rest.wormbase.org currently serves a Cloudflare bot challenge to automated clients, so this tool returns HTTP 403; ToolUniverse does not attempt to bypass it. For C. elegans genes use the Alliance of Genome Resources tools (Alliance_get_gene with a 'WB:WBGene...' ID, Alliance_get_gene_phenotypes, Alliance_get_gene_orthologs, Alliance_get_disease) instead.

cross_references.description: The gene in other databases, from the record the overview already fetched

reference_curies.description: Papers Alliance has for the gene

notes.description: Every related note, where `description` takes only the first

name: WormBase_get_phenotypes
description: Get phenotype annotations for a C. elegans gene from WormBase. Returns observed phenotypes (from RNAi, mutation, transgene experiments), phenotypes not observed, and total counts. Phenotype data uses the WormBase Phenotype Ontology (WPO). Example: WBGene00006763 (unc-26) has 125+ observed phenotypes including locomotion defects, synaptic vesicle recycling abnormalities, and pharyngeal pumping defects. NOTE: rest.wormbase.org currently serves a Cloudflare bot challenge to automated clients, so this tool returns HTTP 403; ToolUniverse does not attempt to bypass it. For C. elegans genes use the Alliance of Genome Resources tools (Alliance_get_gene with a 'WB:WBGene...' ID, Alliance_get_gene_phenotypes, Alliance_get_gene_orthologs, Alliance_get_disease) instead.

reference_details.description: Each reference with the identifiers it can be cited by. The curie alone is Alliance's own key (AGRKB:101000000617864) and nothing outside Alliance takes it; the cross-references hold PMID:10931870, the DOI and WBPaper00004275.

pubmed_ids.description: PubMed ids Alliance lists for the row

annotation_types.description: e.g. AllelePhenotypeAnnotation. An allele phenotype is a different weight of evidence from an RNAi or a transgene one, and the statement alone does not say which.

annotation_references.description: Each reference with the identifiers it can be cited by. The curie alone is Alliance's own key (AGRKB:101000000617864) and nothing outside Alliance takes it; the cross-references hold PMID:10931870, the DOI and WBPaper00004275.

data_provider.description: Which database curated it; Alliance aggregates several

subjects.description: WHICH ALLELE. The annotation's subject is not the gene: for an AllelePhenotypeAnnotation it is the specific allele -- m2 (WB:WBVar00088530) for unc-26's "aldicarb resistant" -- and inferred_gene is the gene it maps back to. Two alleles with different phenotypes used to arrive as one undifferentiated list.

subject_curie.description: Alliance curie of the gene the rows are grouped under

name: WormBase_get_expression
description: Get expression data for a C. elegans gene from WormBase. Returns tissues where the gene is expressed, developmental stages, subcellular localization, and expression clusters. Expression data is curated from GFP reporters, antibody staining, RNA in situ, and microarray experiments. Example: WBGene00006763 (unc-26) is expressed in 38 tissues including neurons, pharynx, and body wall muscle. NOTE: rest.wormbase.org currently serves a Cloudflare bot challenge to automated clients, so this tool returns HTTP 403; ToolUniverse does not attempt to bypass it. For C. elegans genes use the Alliance of Genome Resources tools (Alliance_get_gene with a 'WB:WBGene...' ID, Alliance_get_gene_phenotypes, Alliance_get_gene_orthologs, Alliance_get_disease) instead.

subject_curie.description: Alliance curie of the gene the rows are grouped under

annotations.description: Each annotation whole. expressed_in, expressed_during and expression_assays are deduplicated sets, so they say WHAT was seen and lose which went with which: "AIYL", "L1 larva" and "reporter gene" arrive as three unrelated sets even though one annotation named them together, with the paper that reported them.

name: WormBase_get_orthologs
description: Get orthologs and homologs of a C. elegans gene across species from WormBase (Inparanoid/EnsEMBL-Compara/OrthoFinder etc.), plus nematode orthologs and within-worm paralogs. Accepts a WBGene ID or gene name (auto-resolved). Example: WBGene00006818 (unc-86) returns cross-species orthologs like zebrafish pou4f4 and nematode orthologs like CSP40.g8217 (c_tribulationis). NOTE: rest.wormbase.org currently serves a Cloudflare bot challenge to automated clients, so this tool returns HTTP 403; ToolUniverse does not attempt to bypass it. For C. elegans genes use the Alliance of Genome Resources tools (Alliance_get_gene with a 'WB:WBGene...' ID, Alliance_get_gene_phenotypes, Alliance_get_gene_orthologs, Alliance_get_disease) instead.

gene_id.description: WBGene identifier or gene name. Examples: 'WBGene00006818', 'unc-86'.

methods_not_called.description: The prediction methods that ran and did NOT call this ortholog. Four of six agreeing is a different claim from four of four, and `methods` alone cannot tell them apart.

confidence.description: Alliance's own confidence label for the pair

name: WormBase_get_interactions
description: Get physical and genetic interactions for a C. elegans gene from WormBase, split into physical and genetic lists with interactor names, IDs, interaction type, and citation. Accepts a WBGene ID or gene name. Example: WBGene00006818 (unc-86) has a physical interactor die-1 (WBGene00000995) and a genetic interactor ttx-3 (WBGene00006654). NOTE: rest.wormbase.org currently serves a Cloudflare bot challenge to automated clients, so this tool returns HTTP 403; ToolUniverse does not attempt to bypass it. For C. elegans genes use the Alliance of Genome Resources tools (Alliance_get_gene with a 'WB:WBGene...' ID, Alliance_get_gene_phenotypes, Alliance_get_gene_orthologs, Alliance_get_disease) instead.

name: WormBase_get_human_diseases
description: Get human disease models (Disease Ontology / DOID) for a C. elegans gene from WormBase, inferred by orthology to human disease genes. Accepts a WBGene ID or gene name. Example: WBGene00006818 (unc-86) is a potential model for DOID:0110546 'autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 15', inferred by orthology to human HGNC:9220. NOTE: rest.wormbase.org currently serves a Cloudflare bot challenge to automated clients, so this tool returns HTTP 403; ToolUniverse does not attempt to bypass it. For C. elegans genes use the Alliance of Genome Resources tools (Alliance_get_gene with a 'WB:WBGene...' ID, Alliance_get_gene_phenotypes, Alliance_get_gene_orthologs, Alliance_get_disease) instead.

gene_id.description: WBGene identifier or gene name. Examples: 'WBGene00006818', 'unc-86'.

description.description: What the Disease Ontology category is

annotation_count.description: How many annotations THIS gene has in the category. Without it every category read as a finding.

groups.description: The subcategories under it, each with this gene's counts

annotated_disease_count.description: This gene's own count. disease_count is the number of ribbon CATEGORIES, which is the same for every gene.
